newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish consumer confidence up in April.
newsitem.headline: Polish consumer confidence up in April.

text.p: Polish consumer confidence indicators, measured by the Demoskop polling institute for the Rzeczpospolita daily, increased in April, Demoskop said on Tuesday.
Demoskop's consumer confidence index was at 101 points in April, up one point from February. It was at 102 points in February.
The business climate index rose to 99 points in April from 94 in March and the index measuring propensity to spend fell to 102 points from 104 points. @
The Demoskop survey was carried out between April 9-14 among a representative random sample of 994 adult Poles.
